method.text:
Partial snapshot. The official MCP Registry (registry.modelcontextprotocol.io, latest version of each server) lists 35,158 unique Streamable HTTP remote URLs. This snapshot checked 13,159 of them (39 % of the list processed) on 2 Nov 2026, 07:38 to 08:28 UTC. 12,362 responded over HTTPS, counting any HTTP response that isn't a firewall or gateway error (404, 500 and sign-in challenges included). Every total on this page counts them. 11,296 of them passed the MCP initialize check (7,995 returned an initialize result, 3,301 asked for OAuth sign-in with valid discovery metadata).

We started by re-checking the URLs that had responded in an earlier pass on the same day, then took the remaining URLs in a random order. So servers that were online earlier today are over-represented, and the share that responds is higher than for the whole registry.

Each URL was checked once with McpStamp Check engine 1.2.0, the same engine as the live check. No credentials, and at most one check at a time per domain. A store is ready when no blocking check failed and every blocking check could run. Unverified means nothing failed, but a blocking check couldn't run (tools behind sign-in, for example). We left out servers that returned HTTP 429, our own servers, and hosts that resolve to private addresses.

Totals cover all 12,362 servers that responded over HTTPS. The table shows a grade-balanced sample of 600 of them. Snapshot deploys refresh this page. It isn't live, so run the live check for the current result of any server.
